newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq slips on broker comments.
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq slips on broker comments.

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq plc slipped on Monday following negative comments from Lehman Brothers on the stock, traders said.
The stock was down 6-1/2p at 462p by 0910 GMT, against the trend of a generally buoyant market.
Analysts at Lehman Brothers said the only reason for holding Allied Domecq shares would be for their high dividend yield and that was not really a good enough reason.
John Wakely, drinks analyst at the brokerage, said Allied may have to raise spending on promoting its brands and increase capital expenditure to meet competition from rivals.
"The only way to afford that is to cut back on the dividend and if they did, the underlying shares would be expensive," he said.
The brokerage said it maintained its "sell" stance on the stock.
